title: n8n Execute Workflow Input
description: Input schema for triggering an n8n workflow execution.

payload.description: Input payload forwarded to the n8n workflow.

wait_for_completion.description: Poll the execution until it reaches a terminal state.

poll_interval_ms.description: Polling interval used when wait_for_completion is true.

completion_timeout_sec.description: Maximum seconds to wait for workflow completion.
